review_candidates.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Singapore
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key responsibilities · Design, deliver and support complex server, storage and infrastructure platforms. About you · 7+ years of experience designing, delivering and operating complex, mission critical server, storage, infrastructure and network environments.
eligibility_evidence: Ready to take your infrastructure career international?
This is a unique opportunity for a permanent employee to relocate to Singapore and work at the forefront of large scale infrastructure engineering.
You will join an international, multidisciplinary team delivering infrastructure platforms for complex operational environments where reliability, security and performance are essential.

Whether you are looking to accelerate your career, gain international experience, or simply embrace a new adventure, this role offers the chance to live and work in one of Asia's leading technology hubs while remaining part of the global Akkodis family.

review_candidates.title: System Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Client Systems Administrator Role Overview The Client Systems Administrator is responsible for integrating, maintaining, and troubleshooting software within a hosting environment, ensuring system accessibility and consistency for end users. The role emphasizes adherence to security policies, escalation of security incidents, and maintaining the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of hosting services.
